scope: Static observed production SDK wait path; no actual settlement runtime acceptance

facts.fact: Session.wait first resolves session then calls execution.awaitIdle; it does not call resume or wake.
RPC exposes both interrupt(resume only) and wait(sessionID). Can compose existing public calls rather than invent private await-settlement RPC.
awaitIdle waits current original execution.done and rechecks map until no active execution, covering cleanup and newly admitted execution during wait.
Actual pinned Promise SDK session.wait(input,requestOptions) returns Promise<void>.

preferred_candidate: Host transition admission hold -> interrupt(resume:false) -> tracked existing session.wait with deadline -> complete pending/child inventory and identity/generation recheck -> install/readback; unknown or unsettled task retains hold. Actual effect proof required.
